_comment: P4-T5 surface registry — one row per reporting surface. Deploy gates: publish-board-portal.yml (kgs) and validate-dashboard.yml (kenetik-dashboards) fail the build if a deployed HTML is not registered here with status 'deployed'. The kenetik-dashboards copy of this file is a pure sync target (sync-website-state-to-dashboards.yml); edit only in kgs architecture/reporting/.

surfaces.name: Reporting Hub
surfaces.url: Cloudflare Pages root (Access-gated) — the single front door; deployed as index.html
surfaces.purpose: Entry hub: one landing page routing every audience (board, executive weekly, daily ops, departments) to its surface, with per-surface data-freshness dots.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: static page + daily 11:30 UTC republish (freshness dots read live from data files)

surfaces.name: Board Intelligence Portal
surfaces.url: /portal/board-intelligence-portal.html (Access-gated); reached from the hub's Board Room
surfaces.purpose: Board/investor-facing intelligence: financials, cohorts, subscriptions, wholesale (incl. AR), creators, milestones.

surfaces.name: Tracker Scoreboard
surfaces.purpose: Weekly-review scoreboard: L1-L3 metric trajectories vs targets, ChangeSet activity, wholesale detail.

surfaces.name: Wholesale
surfaces.purpose: Wholesale domain page (P6B-T2): full depth — Pulse / Accounts / Margin / Cash / Pipeline, account worklists, AR aging. Moved out of the Scoreboard's Wholesale tab (which keeps a summary + link here). Admin app linked prominently.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (wholesale analysis ~6:15 ET) + daily 11:30 UTC republish

surfaces.name: Creators
surfaces.purpose: Creator domain page (P6B-T3): order-grounded creator economics (new-vs-returning, directional CAC) + the board's Creator-Partnerships operational detail (equity partner cards, non-equity leaderboard, tier & health trends, customer quality). Moved out of the Scoreboard Creators tab and the Board portal (both keep summaries + link here).
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (Superfiliate roster refresh) + daily 11:30 UTC republish

surfaces.name: Daily Pulse
surfaces.purpose: Thin morning surface (P6B-T4): per-domain status strip (paid media, subscriptions, VoC, wholesale AR, creators) with freshness dots + links to each domain page, plus a flags section. Depth lives on the domain pages. Filename kept as ops-dashboard.html for bookmarks.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily morning check (reads state files written ~6:00–6:30 ET) + daily 11:30 UTC republish

surfaces.name: Paid Media
surfaces.purpose: Paid-media domain page (P6B-T1): full depth — pixel/platform/MER KPIs, spend-by-campaign, platform + campaign tables, creative-health / ad drill-down (#campaigns, #creative). Moved out of the Ops Dashboard.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (exec BI chain ~6:00 ET) + daily 11:30 UTC republish

surfaces.name: Partnerships
surfaces.purpose: Partnerships domain page: research-partnerships / BD relationship tracker — active + pursued relationships across NCAA programs, pro sports, the physician network, researchers / KOLs, and summit vendors. Needs-attention strip, segment/status/search/sort, per-contact staleness. Folded in from the retired dashboards/brandon/ dashboard 2026-07-13.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: manual — refreshed on demand (Brandon / Cowork; /summit-tracker) + daily 11:30 UTC republish. No automated writer (see summit-tracker.md note).

surfaces.name: Weekly Trends
surfaces.purpose: ISO-week medians of the daily digest metrics (P3-T3/T4); 26-week rolling window.

surfaces.name: Marketing Dashboard (v2, consolidated)
surfaces.purpose: Campaign/content/task view for the marketing team (BIG CAMPAIGNS + content calendar + team tasks + retail).
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (Task 2a writes calendar; team edits ad hoc) + daily republish
surfaces.note: P4-T4/T4b resolved: marketing-calendar-dashboard.html retired to a redirect stub pointing here; Calendar tab is the canonical calendar viewer.

surfaces.name: Marketing Calendar Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Redirect stub to marketing-dashboard.html (calendar editor retired 2026-07-11, P4-T4b; bookmarks preserved).
surfaces.note: P4-T4b executed: editor retired; marketing-dashboard.html Calendar tab is the canonical viewer. Row retained because the dist gate checks deployed basenames.

surfaces.name: KGS System Map
surfaces.purpose: Static visual map of the KGS pipeline/architecture for orientation.

surfaces.name: Wholesale Admin (input app)
surfaces.purpose: Authed input app for wholesale account edits; writes to Supabase (read-only portal rule does not apply). Gated by Supabase Auth + RLS, not Cloudflare Access.
surfaces.deploy: publish-wholesale-admin.yml -> gh-pages-wholesale-admin -> Cloudflare Pages (no Access; app self-gates on Supabase session)

surfaces.name: Dept Dashboards (redirect stub)
surfaces.purpose: Redirect stub to scoreboard.html; retired from the deploy in P2-T5.

surfaces.name: Connections Tracker
surfaces.purpose: Ad-hoc relationship/connections tracker prototype; never wired into the deploy.

surfaces.name: Creator Capacity Planner
surfaces.purpose: Modash-fed creator capacity planning prototype; never wired into the deploy.

surfaces.name: ChangeSet Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: ChangeSet pipeline view: tracker statuses, work queue, impact rollup (D3 rewrite, D4-gated).

surfaces.name: Website Experiment Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Auto-optimize experiment surfaces: state, clarity snapshots, website-state trends.

surfaces.name: Kenetik Network Viewer
surfaces.purpose: Mermaid network diagrams of KGS roles/processes (network-diagrams/*.mermaid).
surfaces.note: Devon to decide retirement; still deployed until then, so it must stay registered
